name: Lifting and handling machines
note: For jacks, lifts, winches, cranes and automated guided vehicles that lift or carry loads, the CBP rulings in the pool turn on where the lifting mechanism and the main structure were made, and they point both ways: a floor jack took the origin of the country that cast and machined its hydraulic power unit and welded its frame and lift arm, while a bottle jack machined and assembled in Thailand from Chinese castings and a Chinese pump stayed Chinese; guided vehicles took Korea's origin where Korea made their main frames or lift assembly, even with a Chinese lifting mechanism or chassis, and one built from Chinese frames and a Chinese lifting mechanism stayed Chinese though its electrics, software and testing were done in Korea. No single part always decides. Not for hand tools, vehicles, stands that only hold a raised load, or 3D printers. Written from 11 CBP substantial-transformation rulings outside the development and held-out splits (D820, D822); every citation was read against its facts and held origin. Costs are illustrative defaults; users edit them.

groups.name: Lifting mechanism and hydraulic power unit
operations: cast or forge and machine the power unit base, cylinder, piston rod, piston head and pump body
assemble the hydraulic power unit with valves and seals, fill it with oil and load test it
stamp and rivet scissor arms, roll-thread the screw rod and build the lift assembly
assemble the winch motor, drum and gearbox

precedent.note: Making the lifting mechanism in the assembly country was part of what decided origin for floor jacks whose hydraulic power units were cast and machined there (N333646, N347256), an engine crane whose power unit was forged and machined in Thailand (N348514), a scissor jack whose arms and screw rod were made in Thailand (N348905), a guided vehicle with a Korean lift assembly on a Chinese chassis (N343416) and a winch with a Thai motor and drum and a Chinese gearbox (N346297). A bottle jack stayed Chinese, where its base and piston head were cast and its pump assembly made, though Thailand machined and assembled them (N344692). A Chinese lifting mechanism did not decide for two guided vehicles whose frames were made in Korea (N337718, N340047).

groups.name: Frame, chassis, arms and boom
operations: laser cut, stamp, bend and weld steel or aluminium into the chassis, frame, lift arms, platform, post and boom
shot blast and powder coat the welded frames
fabricate the handling frame, roll tray or support frame of a guided vehicle

precedent.note: The main structure was part of what decided origin for floor jacks (N333646, N347256), a scissor jack (N348905) and an engine crane (N348514); scissor lifts took the origin of Poland when two of their three major structural subassemblies, the platform and the chassis, were made there (N334276); guided vehicles took the origin of the country that made their frames: Korea for a Korean lower frame and handling frame (N337718), and for Korean chassis and vertical frames (N340047), and China when both frames were made in China (N336445). A Chinese drive plate chassis did not decide for a guided vehicle whose lift assembly and frame were Korean (N343416).

groups.name: Drive, controls and electrical parts
operations: fit drive motors, reducers, wheels and casters
install controllers, sensors, safety lasers, batteries and wiring harnesses

precedent.note: Adding the drive assembly, battery, controllers, cameras and cabling in Korea did not change the origin of a guided vehicle whose frames and lifting mechanism were built in China (N336445).

groups.name: Final assembly
operations: join the power unit or lift assembly, frames and arms with pins, bolts and fasteners
grease, fill with oil, paint and label the machine
load the control software, calibrate, inspect and test
pack the parts unassembled for assembly by the buyer

precedent.note: Machining imported castings, welding the cylinder and pump to the base, pressing in the piston, filling, painting and testing in Thailand did not change a bottle jack's Chinese origin (N344692); connecting, wiring, loading software, calibrating and testing in Korea did not change a guided vehicle's Chinese origin (N336445).
